title: Record-breaking El Nino raises prospect of warmer, wetter winter in Korea
caption:
The strongest El Nino since 1950 is reshaping Korea's winter. Expect higher temperatures and more rain through December, though January could still bring sharp cold snaps.

Source: Koreaherald - Record-breaking El Nino raises prospect of warmer, wetter winter in Korea
